{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.32

|arg= global
|eff= global

|gr1= Unit Inventory

|descr= Removes backpack from a unit. (even non-local)

|s1= [[removeBackpackGlobal]] unit

|p1= unit: [[Object]] - soldier

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>removeBackpackGlobal player;</sqf>

<dl class="command_description">

<dt></dt>
<dd class="notedate">Posted on 2016-05-08 - 18:00 (UTC)</dd>
<dt class="note">[[User:Nelis75733126|Nelis75733126]]</dt>
<dd class="note">
Because of AG (Arguments Global), you can use this command to remove the backpack from UNITS that are local as well as REMOTE.
<sqf>removeBackpackGlobal UNIT;</sqf> where UNIT can be a local and/or REMOTE player and/or AI
</dd>
